workspaceScript.description: The script, its variables and its state.

configured.description: True once anything has been saved; false means the page is empty.

enabled.description:
Whether sessions created from now on run the script. Off is draft mode:
only sessions created with workspace_script_test run it.

updatedBy.description: Email of the last editor; empty before the first save.

items.description:
WorkspaceScriptVariable is one variable of the workspace script
(docs/workspace-script/DESIGN.md): plain, secret or protected, exactly as
a template variable.

isSecret.description:
Encrypted at rest and masked in the UI; an editor can read it back
with include_secrets.

key.description:
Environment variable name the script receives. Names starting with
"RDE_" are reserved.

protected.description: Write-only: never returned, replaced but never viewed. Implies is_secret.

value.description:
The value. Masked for a secret unless include_secrets was asked; always
empty for a protected variable, which is never returned.

valueStored.description:
True when a value is stored for this key; the UI shows "Set" for a
protected variable instead of the value.
